text: Nera'thor was a fel orc blademaster guarding Magtheridon's Black Temple in Outland. He was killed in the assault against the Citadel orchestrated and conducted by Illidan, Vashj, Akama, and Kael'thas.
Nerrist is an orc trade goods vendor located in Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
Nergal is a dwarf general goods, meat and drink vendor located at Marshal's Stand in the Un'Goro Crater. He was previously found at Marshal's Refuge.
Nerog is an orc inscription trainer found in the shop Mighty Pen on the balcony level of the Drag in Orgrimmar. He can be found speaking with Zilzibin Drumlore.
Nerwalla Malword is an orc follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Neth'raza Doomrend is an orc follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Nether-Ace Verik is a fel lord located at the Terminus in the Antoran Wastes.
Neri Sharpfin is a gilgoblin and the leader of the Unshackled.
Neophyte's Mace was the starting weapon for blood elf priests.

New Thalanaar is a night elf outpost located in the far east of Feralas, and was built after the original Thalanaar was flooded. It is currently under siege by Grimtotem forces. As a result Alliance players are quickly asked to make their way out of the war zone to the dock where a boat awaits to take them to Fizzle and Pozzik's Speedbarge. New Thalanaar remained under siege by the Grimtotem for several months. There is a one-way trip here from Shadebough via a quest from , a refugee from Thalanaar.
Nethergarde Mage is a human located in Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

Neva was a night elf trained by Maiev Shadowsong to be a member of a new generation of Watchers. She was Maiev's second in command and was brutal, seductive, and fanatically loyal to Maiev and her goals. She attempted to flirt with Jarod Shadowsong multiple times and later to assassinate him without Maiev's knowledge because she felt that he was a danger that Maiev didn't recognize yet. She killed the worgen Eadrik when he attempted to rescue Jarod from being murdered, but with Eadrik distracting her, Jarod was able to stab her neck with a glaive. She told Jarod Maiev's plans in exchange for a quick death.
Neve Axeblow is a dwarf paladin located at Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Netherwalk is a Havoc demon hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Desperate Instincts.

Nethermaven Donna Chastain is a character that appears on the following World of Warcraft: Trading Card Game cards. *Wrathgate #125 - Nethermaven Donna Chastain *Class Starter 2011: Alliance Priest #18 - Nethermaven Donna Chastain *Class Starter 2011: Alliance Warlock #20 - Nethermaven Donna Chastain

Nezar'Azret was a nerubian queen of Azjol-Nerub who was killed by Arthas Menethil and the traitor king Anub'arak in the Upper Kingdom of Azjol-Nerub. As a queen, Nezar'Azret was both leader and mother to her subjects.

Nidavelir is an Iron dwarf village in the northwestern area of the Storm Peaks and just to the southwest of the Snowdrift Plains. They are sending Nidavelir Mole Machines to attack Bouldercrag the Rockshaper's forces.
Night Elf Druid was a night elf located in Spires of Arak. She was taken out by the followers sent from the Frostwall garrison.
Nicole Gillet is a human general goods vendor located at Victor's Point in the Twilight Highlands.

Niall Frostdrift is a dwarf frost mage located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn. Prior to the battle for the Broken Shore, like many other followers, he appears in Stormwind Harbor at the sparring ring, where champions duel in preparation for the assault on the Broken Shore.
Nicholas Divide is a human paladin located at Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Nichole Swann is a human found at the blacksmithing workshop just outside Bronzebeard's Vault in Stormshield. She spends her time repairing broken swords.
Nicholas Louie is a tauren deck captain found on the Horde navy transport ship in the Frostwall Shipyard.
Nicolas Moal is a human located in Pinky's Groggery in Boralus. He sells a number of rare and unique alcoholic beverages.
Niadre is a green dragon located at the Garden Shrine in Thaldraszus. She can be found talking with Tea Master Kormin.
Nightwatcher Thaldrys is a night elf ghost located in the Ruins of Nar'thalas in Azsuna during Trailing the Tidestone.
Nillen Andemar is a dwarf mace vendor located on the Stonewrought Dam in Loch Modan.
Nioma is a Wildhammer dwarf leatherworking vendor located in Wildhammer Keep at Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands.
Nina Lightbrew is a human alchemy vendor located on the top floor of the tower in Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands. It's unknown if she survived the Ironmarch.
Noble's Robe is an quality cloth armor chest piece with bonuses to stamina, spirit, and critical strike rating.
Niriap is a goblin general goods vendor located at Nozzlepot's Outpost in the Northern Barrens.
Niluut is a night elf inscription supplies vendor located in Whisperwind Grove in Felwood.
Nisstyr is the Horde warlock leader in Warspear Outpost, Ashran. He serves as the Warlock Gateways NPC for the Horde in Ashran. He has a Succubus minion.
Noah Munck is a human paladin located at Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Nissa Flamestrider is a blood elf healer located at in Talador.
Ninja Pepe is a Pepe bird with a ninja outfit on found in Gorgrond.
Nissa Snowpick is a dwarf located at Bronzebeard's Vault in Stormshield. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, she was seen in Val'sharah.
Nikeson was a human who fought against the Syndicate in Arathi Highlands. He fell and his badge was taken by his killer, kept as a trophy until its retrieval by hired adventurers.

Nikolai is a human who resided in Dalaran before the Third War. The diary named STAY OUT!!! mentions how a companion of sorts had affections for him while trying to resist the whispers of Ner'zhul as the Lich King. It is unknown what happened to him.
Ninette Shoames is a human located at Tradewinds Market in Boralus. Every day, Ninette sets out her wares at the fountain there.
Nina Martinel is a human located in Dock 1 Exports in Boralus.
Nimisia Azuresong is a blood elf located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Alliance players.
Nimbo Zintree is a gnome who wrote to Fizzle Goblinseer about a girl he fell in love with.

Nori Pridedrift is a dwarf found in Coldridge Valley of Dun Morogh. Nori makes his living selling Scalding Mornbrew to the residents of Coldridge Valley. The reason the locals love the stuff is because it comes piping hot. Nori, who wanders the valley delivering his special brand of brew, enlists the aid of others who are willing to deliver this coffee-like morning drink to earn a cut of his sales. He values his limited supply of mugs.

Normantis is a human mage. During the war against the Lich King he was a member of the Kirin Tor located in Borean Tundra in Northrend known as Librarian Normantis. By the time of the third invasion of the Burning Legion, he was ousted from the Kirin Tor and moved to Azsuna on the Broken Isles and is known as Normantis the Deposed.
Noggra is an orc general goods vendor found at the Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.

Nortet is a jungle troll warrior trainer located in the Darkspear Training Grounds on the Darkspear Isle in the Echo Isles in Durotar. When Zalazane returned during the Fourth War, he defended the area.
Nohi Plainswalker is a tauren hunter trainer located in the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar. After Vol'jin's death, he was speaking with Shalla Whiteleaf.

Nodd Codejack is a gnome member of the SI:7 who was tasked by King Varian Wrynn to find the White Pawn in Pandaria. After the Skyfire arrived in the Jade Forest, he immediately began helping with eliminating the Horde presence stationed there. Some time later, he decoded Anduin's journal that helped reveal more about his whereabouts. Nimm and Nodd were later out in a submarine when the Horde attacked Lion's Landing.
General Norris was an officer of the Theramore Guard. Dissatisfied with Major Davin's attitude, Colonel Lorena imagined writing a letter of reassignment for him to Lady Jaina and General Norris.

Lieutenant Noroj was a Theramore soldier under Colonel Lorena. When Lorena received an order from Kristoff to lead Northwatch Hold's forces, Noroj was amongst those whom Lorena chose as her senior staff. However, Lorena did not go to Northwatch and instead went to search Jaina Proudmoore. She succeeded and Noroj and the others returned to Theramore Isle. It is unknown whether he survived the destruction of Theramore.
Nordaerin Silverbeam is a night elf located at Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.

Noreen Trueflint is a dwarf located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, she joined the Unseen Path in the Trueshot Lodge. She is seen speaking with Rumelda Bloodslur.
Nolan Burnbrick is a dwarf banker located at Bronzebeard's Vault in Stormshield.
Nor'gruk Rotskull is an orc follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.

Nokrar was a proud loyal orc warrior of the Frostwolf clan, who greatly respected Durotan. However following the loss of their home from a volcano eruption and Durotan's refusal to join the Horde, Nokrar would reluctantly challenge his Chieftain. Though winning Durotan would refuse to kill Nokrar arguing that too many Frostwolf lives had been lost. Nokrar, still convinced to join the Horde, would take his family and leave and Durotan would give chase to prevent the loss of Frostwolf lives. While Nokrar's family would be recovered, Nokrar was killed and eaten by the Redwalkers, a fact that would horrify Durotan.
Nolan Speed is the SI:7 commander leading the Alliance's efforts in Silithus: The Wound.
Nonash is a night elf located in Black Rook Hold. He was taken out by the champions of the class orders.

Nordric Albrite is a human located in the Arathi Highlands. He can be found in a small house, dancing with (presumed wife) Greta Albrite. If Arathi is controlled by the Horde and Horde adventurers confront them, he will say: with his fists up and with Greta cowering behind him.
Novice Ranger is a blood elf ranger located in Falconwing Square in Eversong Woods. He stands in front of the Wanted Poster and is interested in the bounty placed on Thaelis the Hungerer.
Norvin Alderman is a human cloak vendor located at the Runeweaver Square in Dalaran. During the purge of Dalaran, he was on the balcony in a fighting stance.
Nostrastrasz is a red dragon who inhabits the Vermillion Redoubt in the Twilight Highlands.
Northpaul is a level 90 Forsaken soldier part of the initial attack on Draenor. He is fighting Iron Horde Grunts alongside many others at the Dark Portal as well as in Tanaan where he is killed.
Not So Tiny Tom is a ogre character in Smokywood Pastures Presents: A Winter Veil Carol.
Northrend Winds is a Frost death knight honor talent, available at rank 25.
Novice's Robe is the starting chest piece for night elf druids.

OMW is an acronym for "On My Way", meaning the Player character is moving toward the recipient(s) of the message or some agreed upon destination. It is generally used when being called for summoning to an Instance or helping someone in a Battleground.

Nyrill is a human located at the foot of Bear's Head below Xylem's Tower. As Archmage Xylem's apprentice, he stands next to a summoning circle adorned with relics and torches. The portal he guards enables travelers to return to Sanath Lim-yo's camp. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, he became a member of Xylem's inner circle. When the adventurer confronted the corrupted archmage, he sent his apprentici to deal with them. When Nyrill was defeated, a shadow emerged from him and he came to his senses.
Novrastrasz is a red dragon located at the Vermillion Redoubt in the Twilight Highlands.
Nurkala is the war leader of a war party consisting of Zandalari Firespear, Zandalari Frostspear, Zandalari Prophet, and Zandalari Fleshrender.
Nyrisse is a night elf leather armor vendor located at Lor'danel in Darkshore.
Nurse Judith is a human nurse located at the Stair of Destiny in Hellfire Peninsula.
Oathblood is a Fury warrior artifact trait. It is linked to the Pulse of Battle and Death and Glory traits.

Quartermaster O'Keefe was a human who fought during the Second War. As a member of Kul Tiras, they were part of the marine army whose battles were all at sea. While on the Gale's Reprieve, they would die during the Battle of Crestfall when red dragons breath fire on their vessels, sending their ships to the bottom of the sea. In the present day, they are one of the Drowned Sailors.
Numernormi is a bronze dragon located in the Valdrakken Treasury Hoard in Valdrakken serving as a banker alongside Vekkalis and Aeoreon. She is accompanied by Humduck Livingsworth the Third.
Nuuna Silversong is a night elf found in the Eye of Ysera in the Emerald Dream.
Obsidian Fists is a Brewmaster monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Hot Blooded and Overflow traits.
Obsidian Lance is a Frost mage artifact trait. It is linked to the Frigidity of the Tirisgarde and Freezing Rain (artifact trait) traits.
Officer Brady is a human found patrolling the streets of Stormwind.
Officer Jankie is a human located at the Tethris Aran in Desolace. She sends the Alliance adventurer to Nijel's Point.

Ocktobrax is a member of the Brazilian Portuguese language CM team on WoW, Starcraft 2 and Diablo 3 Brazilian forums. He was the third Community Manager for Brazilian community. He was announced in a forum post. [http://us.battle.net/wow/pt/search?f=post&a=Ocktobrax&sort=time Most Recent posts on Brazilian World of Warcraft forum]

Oengus was a Wildhammer dwarf during the Second War. He was one of the Wildhammers who fell during the second raid on the orcs in the Hinterlands when they started throwing spears. His death was reported to Kurdran by Iomhar.

Officer Jeor is a dwarf located in Lunarfall in . He appears in the garrison's Town Hall when a level 3 Barracks is built. He can recruit Lunarfall Guards and additional Lunarfall Riflemen for the garrison.

Odyn is one of the titan Keepers and the ruler of the Valarjar in the Halls of Valor. Once the Prime Designate of Azeroth, he was cursed by his daughter Helya to be trapped in the Halls of Valor along with his army. Despite his curse, Odyn could still leave the halls in the form of a vrykul named Havi as shown repeatedly, or under his true form in short bursts. Among the vrykul, Odyn is worshipped as a storm god and the king of the gods. He is stated to follow the Light by the Bronzebeard brothers, with his Val'kyr shieldmaidens being referred to as warriors of the Light.
Helya's Wrath is a Fury warrior major artifact trait. It is linked to the Helya's Wrath (artifact trait) and Wrath and Fury (artifact trait) traits.
Ogoroth is a beholder demon located in the Sanctuary of the Light at Netherlight Temple during The Defense of Netherlight Temple scenario.
Obstinate Determination is a Brewmaster monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Gifted Student and Face Palm (artifact trait) traits.
Occultist Prisoner is a human prisoner of Jubeka Shadowbreaker located in Felsurge Nest in Azsuna.
Officer Jovan is a human located at Greystone Relief in Tiragarde Sound. He was one of Fernn's mutineers, but is now a captive of the loyalists.
Odd Pete is a human located in Deadwash in Stormsong Valley.
Officer Reynald is a human located at Fort Daelin in Stormsong Valley.
Off-Duty Soldiers is a human located in Southport in Spires of Arak. He dances.
Officer Redfen is a human located in Gol Thovas in Tiragarde Sound.
Off Balance is a debuff applied to death knights whenever they change weapons during combat. It temporarily prevents the death knight from benefitting from any Runeforging enchantments.
Ochresera is a green dragon located at Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus. She is found talking with Naralex.
Okothos Ironrager is an orc located in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar.

Ogtinc is a furbolg hunter located upon a cliff overlooking the Ruins of Eldarath southeast of Timbermaw Hold in Azshara. He left his tribe in order to aid the Cenarion Circle. He has been missing since the Cataclysm.

Olaf is a dwarf found at the Alliance encampment Dragon's Mouth in the Badlands. Olaf appears in Frostwall Tavern / Lunarfall Inn on . He and his brothers had ventured to Draenor in order to help with the war effort but were imprisoned in the Bloodmaul Slag Mines. Olaf wants his shield retrieved from the mine.
Ogromm is an orc hunter trainer located in Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows.

Okla is a young orc female who lives with her father, Kranal Fiss, near Grol'dom Farm in the Northern Barrens. She loves nothing more than to collect pretty rocks outside, which she hopes to use to make herself a necklace. She is a friend to Gruk who can be found near Thorn Hill, sometimes she finds a sharp rock that Gruk may find useful because he's making a spear.
Okril'lon Mage is an orc found in Cenarion Hold in Silithus,

Ol' Durty Pete is a dwarf located at Teegan's Expedition in the Southern Barrens. He has seen his share of adventure, but Corporal Teegan is none too fond of him. Along with , he is described by as a "crotchety" hunter. He has a blunderbuss. A Ferocious Jungle Vine was accidentally summoned by Corporal Teegan with a Bramblestaff (quest item), and it grabbed Pete. It was quickly killed by Goucho. Interacting with him, one can say, "Tell me a story, Ol' Durty Pete!" He will then tell some rather tall tales. After the death of Deathwing, during one of his night shifts in the camp, he stumbled upon a wounded Alliance scout who revealed that the Horde was heading for Northwatch Hold.
Ogreskull Boneplate Battlegear is the tier 17 death knight set.
Oisin Cragshot is a dwarf located at Lunarfall in . He would accept the turn-in of various items in exchange for Garrison Resources.

Ogrik Wolfclaw is an orc shaman who lives in Orgrimmar. Over a year ago, his sister left to explore the South Seas and he never heard from her again. Worried about her fate, Ogrik consulted the spirits and divined that she was on Plunder Isle. "Dead but not dead", came the cryptic response. The orc believed that she had been turned to stone by the local basilisks, and so he hired a group of adventurers and entrusted them with a box, supposedly full of spirits that would turn ﬂesh back to stone, stating to open it when they were near her. If they could not ﬁnd her alive, or were unable to restore her, Ogrik instructed them instead to recover her axe, which was a Wolfclaw family heirloom. Once
Ogros Blazeseer is an orc located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Alliance players.

Ohn Kanosung is a centaur spirit who roams the southwestern corner of the Ohn'iri Springs in the Ohn'ahran Plains, walking back and forth between the entrance of the large tent and the edge of the lake. He is normally invisible and can only be seen while the player character is under the effect of Essence of Awakening. Gifting him an Aeriform Speck is required for Honor Our Ancestors.
Ol' Hestorath is a proto-dragon located at the top of a tower in Apex Canopy in the Waking Shores.
Olmin Burningbeard is a dwarf hunter trainer located in the Hall of Arms in the Military Ward in Ironforge.

Old Man Heming is a human fish vendor located in a shop called The Happy Bobber on the lowest platform of Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn. Prior to patch 3.1 he sold the fishing book Expert Fishing - The Bass and You, which has since been removed. Expert Fishing can now be learned from fishing trainers. Heming now sells only fishing lures, and occasionally the Aquadynamic Fish Attractor. The easiest way to find Old Man Heming is to leap into the water and swim to the ramp that leads out of the water. From there, turn right and you will see him standing in his shop. The shop has an overhang, held up by a single wooden pillar, with a sign hanging from it.
Olthran Craghelm is a dwarf heavy armor vendor located at the Military Ward within Ironforge. He is one of the owners of Craghelm's Plate and Chain.
Old Man Robert is a human located at Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra.
Olivia Zenith is a human working in Angelista's Boutique in Old Stratholme.

Olgra was an orc warrior and the wife of Mankrik. She and her husband battled a group of Bristleback quilboar in a small tauren camp in the Barrens, with Olgra holding off three Bristlebacks by herself, when they became separated. Mankrik saw her overwhelmed by the quilboar and was in turn brought down by the Bristlebacks, but was found by a tauren druid and brought to the Crossroads. From there he asked adventurers to find his lost wife, but when they found her at a hut near the Lushwater Oasis, she was already dead. Mankrik later retrieved Olgra's body and buried her at the Grol'dom Farm next to a humble monument. After her death, Olgra's soul was sent to Maldraxxus where she became a glad
Old Hillpaw is a pandaren chicken farmer and a member of the Tillers.

Old Lady Fung is a pandaren resident of Firebough Nook; she was one of the few villagers to survive to the attack of the sha-possessed yaungol, along with Sya Zhong, Ya Firebough and Jin Warmkeg. All of them were rescued and led them to safety to Shado-Pan Fallback by an adventurer.

Omasum Blighthoof is a tauren death knight located in the Plaguewood of Eastern Plaguelands under the command of Aurius Rivendare. He and Karthis Darkrune are guarding the entrance to Stratholme. They received a letter from Baroness Anastari, claiming that if they keep the plaguewoods secured, they would earn a new comrade.
Old Salty Sullivan is a dwarf with the Anglers located throughout Pandaria. His location changes daily with the location of special fishing pools noted by Ben of the Booming Voice.
Olren Sternbeard is a dwarf shaman located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Olivia Abbington is a human innkeeper located at the Fort Wrynn in Talador.

Omril Keenedge is an orc follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern. Prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore, like many other followers, he appears at the Dranosh'ar Blockade at the sparring ring, where champions duel in preparation for the assault on the Broken Shore.

Olothil Starlance is a night elf located in Ruins of Nar'thalas in Azsuna. He and his sister Kallista went to Azsuna from Dalaran seeking the spirits of their long-deceased parents. He is often the accidental target of his sister's impulsive spell-flinging.
Olena Marisport is a human located at Norwington Estate in Tiragarde Sound.
Olive is a human located at Eastpoint Station in Tiragarde Sound.

Olfig Ironroar is a dwarf located in the Boulderfist Outpost in the Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde. Olfig is being imprisoned by Kor'gresh Coldrage. Once Kor'gesh is killed, Olfig escapes.
Olson Brightshield is a human located in the Siege of Boralus.
Ollie Oakman is a human located in Ashvane Foundry in Tiragarde Sound.
Oliva is a human innkeeper located at the Castaway Encampment in Zuldazar.

Onslaught Commander Iustus is a human located at the Onslaught Base Camp in Dragonblight. He ambushed a group of the 7th Legion and so he is wanted dead by the Alliance. A wanted poster was put up by Highlord Leoric Von Zeldig.
Onana is an orc vendor located at the Frostwolf Overlook in Talador.
One Against Many is an Arms warrior artifact trait. It is linked to the Defensive Measures, Thoradin's Might, and Touch of Zakajz traits.

OptionHouse is a general master control panel, performance monitor, and centralized configuration mod for your addons. When installed as a separate addon, you can enable and disable addons, load addons that are LoadOnDemand, as well as get general addon metadata. You can use the included performance monitor to sort your addons by memory usage, memory increase per second, along with CPU usage if you have CPU profiling enabled. First and foremost, OptionHouse was designed to allow an easy centralized place to configure your addons. The library provides a way to categorize your options, and only creates those options screens which are access. In short, this addon will give you a nice place to c

Orbiss is the leader of the Townlong Steppes mistlurker tribe who reside in the Lower Sumprushes and Upper Sumprushes. When the yaungol mist shamans come to enslave the mistlurkers, he is wounded by a spear which causes him to become more incorporeal and regress into mist as the quest line goes on. His partners are Arconiss and Golgoss. He has a strong sense of pride and is very devoted to protecting his people.
Orbital Strike is a Frost mage artifact trait. It is linked to the Icy Caress and Chilled to the Core (mage artifact trait) traits.
Operations Officer is a human located at the Stair of Destiny in Hellfire Peninsula. He isn't very good at keeping his Wounded Soldiers alive.

Orhan Ogreblade is the leader of the Stonemaul ogres in Stonemaul Hold in Feralas. She asked the Horde adventurer to kill the Gordunni ogres in the High Wilderness in order to claim it for the Horde, reduce the numbers of the Gordok class in both inner and outer Dire Maul, as well as to obtain an orb that their warlocks carried. When she looked at it, she found out it was corrupted and figured out that someone was supplying the Gordunni, and she wanted to know who. Orhan sent the adventurer ahead to disrupt the Twilight's Hammer's sermon at the Maul, and then she led a group of Stonemauls against Cho'gall and his followers, with Orhan personally attacking the twisted ogre-mage. Before the Ho

Private Oreil was a soldier of Northwatch Hold and Major Davin's aide. No matter how many times the young private was fitted, his armor was always too big on him. He was sent to request for reinforcements from Theramore through a scrying stone. Later on, he reported that orcs and trolls were approaching Northwatch. It is unknown whether he survived the destruction of Northwatch and Theramore.

Orgek Ironhand is an orc blacksmith located in the Frostwall's Forge. For blacksmiths, he will sell new formulas. For non-blacksmiths, he will make items instead. Prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore, he appears at the Dranosh'ar Blockade, preparing armor polish for the troops.
Orgriz Crookmaw is an orc follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Orc Shaman was an orc located in Talador. She was taken out by the followers sent from the Lunarfall garrison.
Organizer Graves is a human located at Hops, Line, & Sinker Brewing in Boralus.
Orc Sea Pup is an orc summoned in Silverpine Forest during Steel Thunder.
Ormyr Flinteye is a dwarf rogue trainer located in the Forlorn Cavern in Ironforge.
Ott is an orc weapon vendor located in Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Otonambusi is a Broken general goods vendor located at Azure Watch in Azuremyst Isle.
Orik Trueheart is a dwarf paladin of the Argent Crusade and the Silver Hand.
Ortrosh is an orc located at Bor'gorok Outpost in the Borean Tundra.

Orphan Matron Aria is a human found in the middle of the Eventide district of Dalaran during Children's Week. Aria begins and ends the Northrend quest chain, revolving around either a Wolvar Orphan or an Oracle Orphan.

Orno Grimtotem is a Magatha loyalist and the leader of the Grimtotem forces invading Mulgore. His Grimtotem forces corrupted the water wells within the region while he made his pass of operations at Stonetalon Pass. However, Baine's forces were able to heal the wells and find out his location. As his Grimtotem Defenders were engaged with Thunder Bluff Braves, Orno was noted to be observing the battlefield before being confronted by an agent of the Horde. During the subsequent battle, Orno became enraged when he realized there was a chance that he could lose. Upon this realization, he stunned his opponent and then was subsequently confronted by Baine Bloodhoof. Seeing this is to be the perfec
Ortezza is a jungle troll hunter trainer located in the Darkspear Training Grounds of the Darkspear Isle on the Echo Isles in Durotar.
Oslow Pliny is a human jewelcrafting vendor found in Highbank of the Twilight Highlands.

Orseus is a night elf found at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore. He assists the player during In Defense of Darkshore. He was present at the grove when the Horde invaded it during the War of the Thorns.

Oskar Digsong is a dwarf found at the Underlight Canyon in the Abyssal Depths. He and his brother were sent by Captain Glovaal to scout the area. But unfortunately for Oskar, he got eaten by an eel. After escaping the beast, he was last seen floating to the surface.
Ornag is an orc weapon vendor located at the Mor'shan Rampart in the Northern Barrens.
Orrindis Raindrinker is a night elf located at Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Orvar is a dwarf located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Osgar Smitehammer is a dwarf paladin located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Orim Steeltoe is a dwarf found in the Hero's Rest Inn in Stormshield.
Orukan is an orc that visits players' garrisons during Hallow's End. She offers daily quests to battle the Bonefleet.
Orrelleon Searingstrike is a blood elf follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Orin Grimblade is a Darkfallen death knight follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Orog is an orc follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Orlana Strongbrow is the spirit of an orc located in the southern cave at Stonefury Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.

Orukai was the first ogre mage to master the arts of enchanting. He created a number of enchanted items known as the Armament of Oru'kai, which were scattered across after his death. The armaments includes a staff, a scepter, two bracers and a number of rings. Delath, an arakkoa arcanist, seeks the armaments.
Osgood was a human who fought against the Syndicate in Arathi Highlands. He fell and his badge was taken by his killer, kept as a trophy until its retrieval by hired adventurers.

Orphan Matron Meliana is a human located in her orphanage in Old Stratholme during the Deaths of Chromie scenario. She seems to be in love with Emery Neill and was responsible for the local orphanage. When Arthas Menethil started the purge of Stratholme, she armed herself with a Refurbished Military Rifle, a bunch of Basic Cloth Bandages and Salted Venison Jerky. She also gave a portion of the jerky to Emery. It is unknown what happened to her during the purge, but the children were evacuated. Like all the other buildings, her orphanage burns to this day.

Chief Osak is a character in a tauren legend. Wanting to help his tribe through winter, he entered a forest and meditated. When no wisdom came, he set out to return to his people, but soon he came upon a startling sight: An old kodo with a pure white hide. The kodo glanced at Chief Osak and kept moving through the forest. Enchanted, Chief Osak followed the kodo, and before long they came upon a clearing. In the clearing was a lake of clean, fresh water, with many fish. Deer drank from it. Chief Osak looked a smile toward the white kodo, then returned to his tribe to tell them where to find food and water. The white kodo is now a symbol of prosperity among the tauren.
Osithra is a green dragon located in the Late Night Lab in Thaldraszus. She is found chatting with Falastrasz and Shimidormi.
Outbreak is a death knight talent located in the 3rd tier of the Unholy tree.
Outfitter Mendelev is a human standing in a tent in Hearthglen in the Western Plaguelands.

Outrider Urukag is an orc of the Frostwolf clan found on the outskirts of Grimfrost Hill with his frost wolf companion Snowpaw. He, along with Balul, Lukar, and Vorg, made an unsuccessful attack on the Grimfrost ogres, and now he sits wounded. He bids adventurers complete his work by slaying Guttra Wolfchew and giving his fellows proper cremations. Once his tasks are done, Urukag dies.
Outrider Vorg is a deceased orc located at Icewind Drifts in Frostfire Ridge.
Outrider Lukar is a deceased orc located at Icewind Drifts in Frostfire Ridge.
Outrider Balul is a deceased orc located at Icewind Drifts in Frostfire Ridge.
Outrider Duretha is an orc found on a hill overlooking a lake in southern .
Oublion is a jailer summoned by on the Broken Shore where he remained for some time. He later traveled to Azsuna where he corrupts the makrura and gilgoblins into attacking the region.
Overflow is a Brewmaster monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Obsidian Fists and Brew-Stache traits.
Outrider Lashan is a human located at Orsis in Uldum during the Assault in Uldum.

Overseer Maltorius is a Dark Iron dwarf found deep in the Slag Pit of Searing Gorge. He is Dig-Boss Dinwhisker's boss and he himself answers to Archduke Calcinder. He has been seen communicating with Twilight-Lord Arkkus, a Twilight's Hammer emissary recently. It's unknown if he has joined them or is preparing to.
Overwatch Mark I is the robot built by the goblin merchant Zixil to guard him as he travels and trades between Southshore and Tarren Mill. It was present during the Legion Invasions.
Overlord Runthak was an orc serving the Horde. When the Horde split between the Darkspear Rebellion and the True Horde, Runthak joined the True Horde and was killed during the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Overseer Deathgaze is a human necromancer found at Jintha'kalar in Dragonblight.

Overlord Bor'gorok is an orc located at the Bor'gorok Outpost in the Borean Tundra. He refused to allow the shaman to heal Ortrosh in order to teach him a good lesson and to give him time to reflect upon his failure.
Overlord Razgor is an orc located at a hut next to the southern gates of Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra.
Owynn Graddock is a dwarf rogue of the SI:7. He has darkly tanned skin and black hair and beard and brown eyes.
Overseer Struk is an orc blacksmithing vendor located in Dreadmaul Hold in the Blasted Lands. Struk fell during the Iron Horde attack on Nethergarde. Her body and shield were found there.
Owato is a tauren general goods vendor located in the Valley of Wisdom of Orgrimmar. After Vol'jin's death, he was seen speaking with an Orgrimmar Brave in front of his tent.
Overseer Brunon is an iron dwarf located at the Ruins of Tethys in Grizzly Hills.
Overseer Durval is an iron dwarf located at the Ruins of Tethys in Grizzly Hills.
Overseer Korgan is an iron dwarf located at the Ruins of Tethys in Grizzly Hills.
Overseer Lochli is an iron dwarf located at the Ruins of Tethys in Grizzly Hills.
Overseer Lurguk is an orc located at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh during Theramore's Fall.
Overseer Gotrigg is an orc found in Blackrock Quarry in Tanaan Jungle during the Assault on the Dark Portal.
Overseer Axefist is an orc located at the Vol'jin's Pride in Talador.
Overseer Mogark is a trogg warrior featured in the Kobolds & Catacombs expansion for Hearthstone. Overseer Mogark is a trogg who appears to be a slavedriver underground.

Owings is a human pirate captain and leader of the Fogsail Freebooters located in Plunder Harbor in Tiragarde Sound. She used to be the first mate to Captain Rhenik but rebelled against him after learning that he sought to sell their freedom to the Ashvane Trading Company. In this endeavor, she was aided by the Horde and thus allowed them the use of Plunder Harbor as foothold within Tiragarde Sound, after which she became its captain.
Overseer Bates is a human located at Anglepoint Packing District in Tiragarde Sound.
Owen Lodgson is a human located in Stormsong Valley. Next to his corpse, a letter he was writing can be found.

Owen Northwood is a human located in Northwood Home in Drustvar. He is not a standard innkeeper but rather rents out his own house, Northwood Home, since the standard inn is full. He is also present during Faction Assaults.
Overseer Zarjish is the apparent leader of the Stormcoil naga in Darkwood Shoal in Vol'dun. He was ordered by Queen Azshara to search the region for the :Ring of Tides.

Overseer Morrison is a member of the Ashvane Trading Company who oversees the :Azerite-mining operation in the Redrock Mines in Vol'dun. She holds a master key that can open any lock in the surrounding compound. She is constantly yelling at the vulpera captives in the mine.
Ozgrom Ragefang is an orc located at the Mugambala in Zuldazar. He sells recipes for a variety of primary professions for Mark of Honor.
Overseer Howling is a human located in Tiragarde Sound. She is one of Fernn's mutineers.
Overseer Xymra is a black dragonspawn who is the leader of the poachers capturing the slitherdrakes at their roost in Zaralek Cavern.
Packmaster Stonebruiser is a dwarf located in Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands. Since the Cataclysm, he also appears in Stratholme Main Gate and Stratholme Service Entrance.
Pain Suppression is a Discipline priest talent. It is an 8 sec buff which reduces all damage taken by 40%. It can be cast while stunned.

Paelarin is a blood elf bow vendor located at Farstrider Retreat in Eversong Woods. Paelarin dislikes trolls with a passion; when trolls talk to him, he will insult them and refuse his services to them.

Packleader Ivar Bloodfang is a worgen and leader of the Bloodfang worgen of Silverpine Forest. Although clever and willing to form alliances with others, he doesn't hesitate to use violence, brutality, and desperate measures to get what he wants. When he witnessed Darius Crowley's decision to retreat from Silverpine, he was no longer impressed with him, but he still assisted the Alliance. He considers the Forsaken his blood enemies.

Pa Maclure is a human farmer found at the Maclure Vineyards in Elwynn Forest. He is the owner of the farm and the patriarch of the Maclure family. He is one of the main driving forces behind the feud between the Maclure and Stonefield families. As a result of the feud, he will not allow his daughter, Maybell Maclure, to court Tommy Joe Stonefield, despite her wishes to do so, resulting in her being forced to meet Tommy Joe secretly. He can be found just outside the Maclure house, near Joshua Maclure.
Packleader Vor'gash is the leader of Mok'gol Watchpost in . He patrols the compound aback his wolf.
Packmaster Grokglok is an orc located at the Grommashar in .
Pain Train was an Arms warrior honor talent, available at rank 8.
Pack Leader is a Beast Mastery hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Pathfinder and Wilderness Expert traits.
Palkar is a young orc of the Frostwolf clan who serves as Drek'Thar's personal attendant.

Paldesse is a high elf cloth armor merchant found in the Runeweaver Square in Dalaran. She sells the tier 7 armor pieces for priests, warlocks, and mages. During the purge of Dalaran, she was cowering in fear.
Palja Amboss is a human blacksmithing vendor found in the Magus Commerce Exchange in Dalaran.
Pandaren Monk is a mini-pandaren that happens to be a monk. It's in the name.
Painmaster Thundrak is an orc found in Silverwind Refuge of Ashenvale. He drives the Wagon of Unending Agony with a number of gnome prisoners, most of them dead.
Pamela was a human from Lordaeron who was suppose to received a final letter to her beloved, during the Third War. Her current whereabouts are unknown.
Palleae is an orc mentioned by the author of the Waterlogged Journal. The author loves them.
Panodormu is a bronze dragon located in the Victorious Visage in Valdrakken. He can be found talking to a Salon Patron.
Parkat Steelfur is a furbolg general goods vendor located at Stillpine Hold in Azuremyst Isle.
Paralysis is a tier 5 Shadow priest talent that causes critical hits from Mind Blast to slow the target by 100% for 2/4 seconds.
Passion's Reward is a human fishing trawler captained by Joq.
Parlan is a Wildhammer dwarf located at Firebeard's Patrol in the Twilight Highlands. Parlan's Ivory Hammer is a quest item for Cailin Longfellow's quest Small Comforts.
Parata is a jungle troll priest trainer located at Sen'jin Village in Durotar. She is on the second floor of the largest hut, speaking with Bomsanchu and Gusini.

Paolo is a veteran soldier under Lorena. He accompanied Lorena and her army out of Northwatch. They were attacked by orcish members of the Burning Blade clan. He was not injured and helped to carry injured Mal. It is unknown whether he survived the destruction of Northwatch and Theramore.
Papa is an orc located in . He was killed by Worgskin the Savage.
Paratrooper Ort is an orc located on a hill overlooking Algerson Lumber Yard in Tiragarde Sound.
Pathfinding is a hunter talent located on tier 3 of the Beast Mastery tree.
Patrick Mills was a human found in Azshara. He came here with Alexandra Blazen aboard the Horizon Scout, for unknown reasons.

Pathonia Shaw was the grandmother of SI:7 leader Mathias Shaw, who considered her made of iron. In her youth, Pathonia was caught three times for stealing, causing the guard of Stormwind to give her the choice of working for them or be hanged. She subsequently chose the kingdom, and when she carried out assassination missions she always made her to disguise them as anything other than what it was. She taught her daughter the trade and when she died, she taught her grandson Mathias. She always wore a grotesque amount of rings.
Patrick Hall is a Forsaken general goods vendor located at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.
Patricia Egan is a human alchemy vendor located in the Agronomical Apothecary within Dalaran.
Patricia Marshall is an human weapon vendor located at the Eastwall Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Pathstalker Draga is an orc located north of the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands.
Patrick Messer is a human stable master located at the Fort Wrynn in Talador.
Pathmaker Hamm is a kobold warrior featured in the Kobolds & Catacombs expansion for Hearthstone. Pathmaker Hamm is a kobold who carves out paths underground using explosives.
Patrick Markson is a human located at Tradewinds Market in Boralus. He sells firearms, but he is also great at fixing just about anything.
Patrick Burns is a human located at Burnsie's Smithey in Boralus.
Pathfinder is a Beast Mastery hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Pack Leader (artifact trait) and Unleash the Beast traits.
Patrick Eckhart is a human located at Eckhart Lodge in Stormsong Valley.
Patient Fisher is a dwarf located in the Dragonscale Basecamp in the Waking Shores.
Pathfinder Chester is a human vendor located in Emberwatch in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Paxton Ganter is a dwarf fishing trainer located on Iceflow Lake in Dun Morogh.

Paymaster Lendry (formerly known as Clerk Lendry) is a human banker located on Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. A nearby chest will grant access to the guild bank. It's unknown if he survived the Attack on Theramore Isle, though an NPC called "Theramore Citizen" in the Siege of Orgrimmar has his exact appearance.
Pavenly is a member of Blizzard Entertainment's Web & Mobile Team. Pavenly posts in the Website Bug Reports forums.

Paymaster Amadi is a human banker located at the Dalaran Merchant's Bank in Dalaran. When Dalaran moved above Karazhan, he mysteriously was uncontrollably floated about the vault by an orb of arcane energy.
Paymaster Chang is a human banker located at the Dalaran Merchant's Bank in Dalaran.
Peach is a human located in the Molten Fields of the Molten Front.
